title: Hash Table with Dictionary and Set Quiz
description: A quick check to review dictionaries, sets, and lookup patterns.

questions.question: When should you use a set?

options.text: When you need to store unique values and check membership quickly
When you need to store duplicate values many times
When you need to change a string directly
When you need to sort a list automatically

questions.explanation: A set stores unique values and is useful for fast membership checks.
